releases.name: Her Revenge
releases.summary: Stuck inside a sealed apartment building, The player has to uncover a massive misunderstanding and save the world.

releases.name: Shark Tales: Reef Rogues
releases.summary: Small fins. Big trouble. Battle underwater swarms solo or with up to four local players in this deep-sea arena roguelite. Evolve oddball weapons, hunt buried stories and outfit a crew that looks as strange as it fights.

releases.name: Cull
releases.summary: Cull is a fast-paced 2D pixel-art action-roguelike set in a dark fantasy world. Battle through relentless waves of enemies, upgrade your abilities, and survive in the heart of darkness!

releases.name: Cielvia-Inherited By Defeat-
releases.summary: Turn defeat into power. Gain new abilities by falling to your enemies, grow stronger with every attempt, and overcome relentless trials in this survivors-like action game. Switch between Light and Dark forms to create your own unique combat style.

releases.name: PALE ANIMUS
releases.summary: Help warrior run through a wacky world of enemies, platforms, complete with over a dozen levels and boss battles. How to play:Throw fire balls and ice balls at monsters. Jump on more monsters to make combos. Jump around and find your way through this pixelated side scroller game.Right Arrow Key - To move forward. Left Arrow Key - To move backward. Up Arrow Key - To jump. Circle Key - To throw fire balls and ice balls.

releases.name: Hustle (Facundo Tabarez)
releases.summary: Hustle is an open-world survival-crafting game and top-down shooter set on a tiny planet. You're a dude hunting down the guy who stole your red cap, exposing your ugly, putrid, bald head. Shoot, gather, craft, build, expand your map, dodge bullets and fight bosses to seek revenge.

releases.name: Anomaly Jobs : Death Row
releases.summary: Same Path again and again. Everything looks familiar, until it does not. Some Anomalies hide in plain sight. Some are hard to spot. Find them, then take the correct exit. Every wrong choice lets the night draw closer.

releases.name: EchoNet
releases.summary: A short psychological horror game, where you and your team attempt to prevent a global economic crash.

releases.name: Thicc Magic. Perky Prelude
releases.summary: The backstory of our kindest, fairest, most humble, and selfless ruler, in the form of a comedic hentai shoot 'em up.

releases.name: Insufferedere: Kuudere
releases.summary: You asked for a tsundere. God gave you a kuudere. A short, choice-heavy comedy romance VN about awkward conversations, anime nonsense, and slowly getting closer to the quiet girl sent to you by God.

releases.name: Just One More Fly
releases.summary: Hunt pesky flies in this first-person swatting game. Clear rooms, earn upgrades, and tackle bigger infestations with swatters, electric rackets, a hand vacuum, and a flamethrower. Place traps, beat your best time, and catch that one last fly.

releases.name: Burg Tag
releases.summary: A fast-paced online multiplayer game of tag built around ridiculously satisfying movement. Wall run, swing, slide and roll through colourful maps, grab chaotic power-ups and do whatever it takes to escape your friends... or tag them.

releases.name: Universal Tidy Up
releases.summary: A surreal first-person tidying adventure. Put lost belongings on shelves, shelves inside bigger shelves, and whole rooms somewhere they belong. Solve strange puzzles as space, scale, and time turn an ordinary sorting job into something much bigger.

releases.name: The Harbour Between Us
releases.summary: A free cozy desktop fishing game about a little harbour and a love that never grew old. Catch fish, enjoy the sunset market, pet the cats, and follow unsent letters to help two old sweethearts find their way back to each other.

releases.name: ROGRID
releases.summary: Minesweeper-style deduction meets roguelike dungeon crawling. Read the colors and shapes of clue blocks to uncover treasure among monsters and traps. Combine classes, skills, and artifacts, and manage health and action points to venture deeper.

releases.name: Grind or Die
releases.summary: Grind or Die is an endless, top-down arena survival game packed with demonic hordes, brutal bosses, randomized upgrades, and character-specific powers. Build your warrior, time your dashes, and fight through waves that grow increasingly unforgiving.
